title.description: Pivot table title displayed above the table

rowDimensions.description: Dimensions that break down the ROWS (left side). Order = hierarchy, outer→inner (general→specific, e.g. region then city). Up to 10.

columnDimensions.description: Dimensions that break down the COLUMNS (top). Max 2. Each distinct value becomes a column group.

values.description: Metrics shown in the cells (up to 20). Each is aggregated per row×column group.

aggregation.description: How to aggregate the metric per cell

expandCollapse.description: Treat row dimensions as an expandable hierarchy (default: true)

showRowTotals.description: Show grand-total column + column-dimension subtotals (default: true)

showColumnTotals.description: Show grand-total row + row-dimension subtotals (default: true)

rowLimit.description: Max number of top-level row groups

sortBy.description: Value column to sort row groups by (defaults to first row dimension)

sortDir.description: Sort direction for row groups (use 'desc' with the main metric)

columnConfig.description: Union of ALL columns referenced by rowDimensions + columnDimensions + values. Feeds the granular data query; the pivot is computed client-side.
